You are auditing ONE CUDA kernel header on a real NVIDIA H100 (sm_90a) build of the SuperGrok1.5 repo (cwd /workspace/SuperGrok1.5). The extension already builds, links, imports, and 10/11 optimizers run; you are hunting LATENT on-device correctness bugs (especially on code paths the grokking race does not exercise, and numeric errors).

Files to read:
 - grokking_optimizers/kernels/sm_90/mamba3_sm90.cuh   (THE kernel)
 - its canonical optimizer math: (none — model kernel)            (compare the device math against this, if applicable)
 - the binding that calls it: grep csrc/bindings/bindings.cpp for the relevant launch_/op name to see the Python->C++ dtype/shape contract.
 - Optionally the Python optimizer grokking_optimizers/optimizers/mamba3.py to see what dtypes/shapes it actually passes.


KNOWN BUG CLASSES already confirmed on this H100 (look for MORE of the same):
 (A) Mixed-dtype paired tensors into a single-template kernel: the kernel
     dispatches on ONE tensor's scalar_type() (e.g. weight) then reads a PAIRED
     tensor (e.g. its bias) with data_ptr<SAME_T>(). If Python can pass them in
     different dtypes (weight bf16 via projection_precision='bf16', bias left
     fp32) -> "expected BFloat16 but found Float" at runtime. (Confirmed: SG2
     input_proj_W bf16 vs input_proj_b fp32.)
 (B) Wrong count/loop-bound: a kernel loops 't < n_tasks' or indexes arr[t]
     where n_tasks / the size were set to the ELEMENT count instead of the
     TASK/entry count, walking a small array out of bounds. (Confirmed: fused_step
     n_tasks=n.)
 (C) at:: host ops mixing bf16 weights with fp32 activations without a .to()
     coercion (e.g. a.matmul(b) where a is bf16 and b fp32).
 (D) reshape/view({-1, K}) where the tensor numel may not be divisible by K
     (dimension-wiring mismatch between the passed config int and the actual
     tensor shape). (Confirmed: SG2 meta-net '[-1,44]' vs numel 192.)
 (E) Missing __syncthreads()/__syncwarp() between dependent shared-memory phases,
     or a grid/block index that can exceed the allocated buffer.
 (F) Numeric divergence from the canonical algorithm header (wrong formula,
     swapped operands, missing bias-correction, wrong beta, etc.).


Method: read the kernel fully. For every kernel that dispatches on a tensor dtype, check that ALL tensors it reads with data_ptr<T>() under that branch are guaranteed that dtype. For every reshape/index, check the dimension is derivable and divides. For optimizer kernels, verify the per-element update matches the canonical header formula EXACTLY (operand order, bias-correction, eps placement). 

Report ONLY findings you can back with a specific code snippet and a concrete reachability argument. Prefer precision over recall: a 'certain' high-severity finding is worth far more than ten speculative ones. If the kernel looks correct, return an empty findings array — that is a valid, valuable result. Return the structured object.

167	template <typename T>
168	inline cudaError_t gemm_rowmajor(
169	    cublasHandle_t handle,
170	    int M, int N, int K,
171	    const T* A, const T* B, T* C,
172	    cudaStream_t stream)
173	{
174	    cublasSetStream(handle, stream);
175	    const float alpha = 1.0f, beta = 0.0f;
176	    cudaDataType_t dt = cublas_traits<T>::dt;
177	    // Row-major: C = A · B  ⇔  C^T = B^T · A^T  (col-major view)
178	    // In col-major: m=N, n=M, k=K, A_in=B (lda=N), B_in=A (ldb=K), C_out=C (ldc=N)
179	    // For float inputs use CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_TF32 so plain-FP32 buffers are
180	    // routed through the TF32 tensor cores (matching the CUTLASS TF32 path and
181	    // gemm_rowmajor_NT's fast-path precision class); bf16/half keep
182	    // CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F (FP32-accumulate), which already selects tensor cores.
183	    cublasComputeType_t ctype =
184	        std::is_same<T, float>::value ? CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_TF32
185	                                      : CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F;
186	    cublasStatus_t st = cublasGemmEx(
187	        handle, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_N,
188	        N, M, K,
189	        &alpha,
190	        B, dt, N,
191	        A, dt, K,
192	        &beta,
193	        C, dt, N,
194	        ctype, CUBLAS_GEMM_DEFAULT_TENSOR_OP);
195	    return (st == CUBLAS_STATUS_SUCCESS) ? cudaSuccess : cudaErrorUnknown;

281	__global__ void embed_kernel(
282	    const int* __restrict__ ids,        // [B, seq_len]
283	    const T* __restrict__ tok_emb,      // [vocab, d_model]
284	    const T* __restrict__ pos_emb,      // [seq_len, d_model]

288	    int bs = blockIdx.y;
289	    int t  = blockIdx.x;
290	    int j  = threadIdx.x;
291	    if (bs >= B || t >= N || j >= D) return;
292	    int id = ids[static_cast<int64_t>(bs) * N + t];
293	    if (id < 0 || id >= vocab) id = 0;

299	// LayerNorm forward: per-row, in-place safe.  out[i,:] = (x - mean)/std * g + b
300	template <typename T>
301	__global__ void layernorm_kernel(
302	    const T* __restrict__ x,            // [M, D]
303	    const T* __restrict__ gamma,        // [D]
304	    const T* __restrict__ beta,         // [D]
305	    T* __restrict__ y,                  // [M, D]
306	    float* __restrict__ saved_mean,     // [M] or null
307	    float* __restrict__ saved_rstd,     // [M] or null
308	    int D, float eps)
309	{
310	    int row = blockIdx.x;
311	    int tid = threadIdx.x;
312	    extern __shared__ float smem[];     // 2 * blockDim.x
313	
314	    // Compute mean and variance via block reduction
315	    float sum = 0.0f, sumsq = 0.0f;
316	    for (int j = tid; j < D; j += blockDim.x) {
317	        float v = to_float<T>(x[row * D + j]);
318	        sum   += v;
319	        sumsq += v * v;
320	    }
321	    smem[tid] = sum;
322	    smem[blockDim.x + tid] = sumsq;
323	    __syncthreads();
324	    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {
325	        if (tid < s) {
326	            smem[tid]               += smem[tid + s];
327	            smem[blockDim.x + tid]  += smem[blockDim.x + tid + s];
328	        }
329	        __syncthreads();
330	    }
331	    float mean = smem[0] / (float)D;
332	    float var  = smem[blockDim.x] / (float)D - mean * mean;
333	    float rstd = fast_rsqrt_nr(var + eps);
334	    if (tid == 0 && saved_mean) saved_mean[row] = mean;
335	    if (tid == 0 && saved_rstd) saved_rstd[row] = rstd;
336	
337	    for (int j = tid; j < D; j += blockDim.x) {
338	        float v = to_float<T>(x[row * D + j]);
339	        float g = to_float<T>(gamma[j]);
340	        float b = to_float<T>(beta[j]);
341	        y[row * D + j] = from_float<T>((v - mean) * rstd * g + b);
342	    }
343	}

360	// Input layout: [B, N, d_inner] (channels-last on last dim, contiguous over time per channel? no — sequence-major).
361	// We treat it as [B, N, d_inner] with the time dimension being N.
362	//   y[b, t, c] = SiLU(b_c + sum_k W[c,k] * x[b, t+k-1, c])     (k in {0,1,2}, pad=1 zero outside)
363	template <typename T>
364	__global__ void conv1d_silu_kernel(
365	    const T* __restrict__ x,    // [B, N, C]
366	    const T* __restrict__ W,    // [C, 3]
367	    const T* __restrict__ bias, // [C]
368	    T* __restrict__ y,          // [B, N, C]
369	    int B, int N, int C)
370	{
371	    int bs = blockIdx.z;
372	    int t  = blockIdx.y;
373	    int c  = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
374	    if (bs >= B || t >= N || c >= C) return;
375	
376	    float w0 = to_float<T>(W[c * 3 + 0]);
377	    float w1 = to_float<T>(W[c * 3 + 1]);
378	    float w2 = to_float<T>(W[c * 3 + 2]);
379	    float bv = bias ? to_float<T>(bias[c]) : 0.0f;
380	
381	    float xm1 = (t > 0)     ? to_float<T>(x[(bs * N + (t - 1)) * C + c]) : 0.0f;
382	    float x0  =                to_float<T>(x[(bs * N + t)       * C + c]);
383	    float xp1 = (t < N - 1) ? to_float<T>(x[(bs * N + (t + 1)) * C + c]) : 0.0f;
384	
385	    float v = w0 * xm1 + w1 * x0 + w2 * xp1 + bv;
386	    // SiLU
387	    float s = v * ptx_sigmoidf(v);
388	    y[(bs * N + t) * C + c] = from_float<T>(s);
389	}

470	// LayerNorm backward: given grad_out [M,D], saved x_norm [M,D] (= (x-mean)*rstd),
471	// saved_mean [M], saved_rstd [M], gamma [D]:
472	//   grad_gamma[j] += sum_rows(grad_out[:,j] * x_norm[:,j])
473	//   grad_beta[j]  += sum_rows(grad_out[:,j])
474	//   dx[i,j] = rstd*(grad_out[i,j]*gamma[j]
475	//              - mean(grad_out*gamma) - x_norm[i,j]*mean(grad_out*gamma*x_norm))
476	// We accumulate grad_gamma/grad_beta with atomicAdd; dx is written directly.
477	template <typename T>
478	__global__ void layernorm_backward_kernel(
479	    const T* __restrict__ grad_out,     // [M, D]
480	    const T* __restrict__ x_norm,       // [M, D]  — (x - mean)*rstd, i.e. normalised
481	    const T* __restrict__ gamma,        // [D]
482	    const float* __restrict__ saved_rstd, // [M]
483	    T* __restrict__ dx,                 // [M, D]
484	    float* __restrict__ grad_gamma_f,   // [D]  float accumulator
485	    float* __restrict__ grad_beta_f,    // [D]  float accumulator
486	    int D, int M)
487	{
488	    // One block per row
489	    int row = blockIdx.x;
490	    int tid = threadIdx.x;
491	    if (row >= M) return;
492	
493	    extern __shared__ float smem2[];   // 2 * blockDim.x floats
494	    float rstd = saved_rstd[row];
495	
496	    // Pass 1: compute dot1 = mean(dout*g), dot2 = mean(dout*g*xnorm)
497	    float sum1 = 0.0f, sum2 = 0.0f;
498	    for (int j = tid; j < D; j += blockDim.x) {
499	        float go = to_float<T>(grad_out[row * D + j]);
500	        float g  = to_float<T>(gamma[j]);
501	        float xn = to_float<T>(x_norm[row * D + j]);
502	        float dg = go * g;
503	        sum1 += dg;
504	        sum2 += dg * xn;
505	        // accumulate weight grads
506	        atomicAdd(&grad_gamma_f[j], go * xn);
507	        atomicAdd(&grad_beta_f[j],  go);
508	    }
509	    smem2[tid]              = sum1;
510	    smem2[blockDim.x + tid] = sum2;
511	    __syncthreads();
512	    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {
513	        if (tid < s) {
514	            smem2[tid]              += smem2[tid + s];
515	            smem2[blockDim.x + tid] += smem2[blockDim.x + tid + s];
516	        }
517	        __syncthreads();
518	    }
519	    float mean1 = smem2[0]              / (float)D;
520	    float mean2 = smem2[blockDim.x]     / (float)D;
521	
522	    // Pass 2: write dx
523	    for (int j = tid; j < D; j += blockDim.x) {
524	        float go = to_float<T>(grad_out[row * D + j]);
525	        float g  = to_float<T>(gamma[j]);
526	        float xn = to_float<T>(x_norm[row * D + j]);
527	        float dxv = rstd * (go * g - mean1 - xn * mean2);
528	        dx[row * D + j] = from_float<T>(dxv);
529	    }
530	}

565	// Gate+skip backward: forward was y_out = (y_scan + xc * D) * silu(z)
566	// Given grad_y_out, compute grad_y_scan, grad_xc_skip, grad_z, grad_D (atomicAdd).
567	template <typename T>
568	__global__ void gate_dskip_backward_kernel(
569	    const T* __restrict__ grad_y_out,   // [rows, d_inner]
570	    const T* __restrict__ y_scan_in,    // [rows, d_inner] — scan output (before gate)
571	    const T* __restrict__ xc,           // [rows, d_inner] — post conv-silu
572	    const T* __restrict__ Dpar,         // [d_inner]
573	    const T* __restrict__ z,            // [rows, d_inner]
574	    T* __restrict__ grad_y_scan,        // [rows, d_inner]
575	    T* __restrict__ grad_xc_skip,       // [rows, d_inner]  (additive)
576	    T* __restrict__ grad_z,             // [rows, d_inner]
577	    float* __restrict__ grad_D,         // [d_inner]   atomicAdd
578	    int rows, int d_inner)
579	{
580	    int r = blockIdx.x;
581	    int c = blockIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
582	    if (r >= rows || c >= d_inner) return;
583	
584	    float gy   = to_float<T>(grad_y_out[r * d_inner + c]);
585	    float ys   = to_float<T>(y_scan_in [r * d_inner + c]);
586	    float xcv  = to_float<T>(xc        [r * d_inner + c]);
587	    float Dv   = to_float<T>(Dpar[c]);
588	    float zv   = to_float<T>(z         [r * d_inner + c]);
589	
590	    float sig_z = ptx_sigmoidf(zv);
591	    float sz    = zv * sig_z;                                    // SiLU(z)
592	    float dsz   = sig_z * (1.0f + zv * (1.0f - sig_z));         // d/dz SiLU(z)
593	    float inner = ys + xcv * Dv;
594	
595	    // grad w.r.t scan output (before D-skip) and xc (D-skip path)
596	    grad_y_scan [r * d_inner + c] = from_float<T>(gy * sz);
597	    grad_xc_skip[r * d_inner + c] = from_float<T>(gy * sz * Dv);
598	
599	    // grad w.r.t z
600	    grad_z[r * d_inner + c] = from_float<T>(gy * inner * dsz);
601	
602	    // grad w.r.t D (per-channel, sum across rows via atomicAdd)
603	    atomicAdd(&grad_D[c], gy * sz * xcv);
604	}

629	    float* __restrict__ grad_b,        // [d_inner]

640	// Conv1d + SiLU backward (depthwise k=3 pad=1).
641	// Forward: xc[b,t,c] = silu(sum_k W[c,k]*x_main[b,t+k-1,c] + bias[c])
642	// We need pre-silu value; recompute from x_main.
643	// Writes grad_x_main_f[b,t,c] += (accumulated from all output positions that read x[b,t,c]).
644	//   NOTE: grad_x_main_f is a FLOAT buffer (not T) to avoid type-punning atomicAdd bugs.
645	//   The caller converts it to T afterward via float_to_T_kernel.
646	// Also accumulates grad_conv_W [d_inner, 3] and grad_conv_b [d_inner] via atomicAdd (float).
647	template <typename T>
648	__global__ void conv1d_silu_backward_kernel(
649	    const T* __restrict__ grad_xc,      // [B, N, C]   gradient w.r.t. conv output
650	    const T* __restrict__ x_main,       // [B, N, C]   conv input
651	    const T* __restrict__ W,            // [C, 3]
652	    const T* __restrict__ bias,         // [C]
653	    float* __restrict__ grad_x_main_f,  // [B, N, C]   float output (atomicAdd)
654	    float* __restrict__ grad_W,         // [C, 3]   atomicAdd float
655	    float* __restrict__ grad_bias,      // [C]      atomicAdd float
656	    int B, int N, int C)
657	{
658	    int bs = blockIdx.z;
659	    int t  = blockIdx.y;
660	    int c  = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
661	    if (bs >= B || t >= N || c >= C) return;
662	
663	    // Recompute conv output (pre-SiLU)
664	    float w0 = to_float<T>(W[c * 3 + 0]);
665	    float w1 = to_float<T>(W[c * 3 + 1]);
666	    float w2 = to_float<T>(W[c * 3 + 2]);
667	    float bv = bias ? to_float<T>(bias[c]) : 0.0f;
668	    float xm1 = (t > 0)     ? to_float<T>(x_main[(bs * N + (t-1)) * C + c]) : 0.0f;
669	    float x0  =                to_float<T>(x_main[(bs * N + t)     * C + c]);
670	    float xp1 = (t < N-1)   ? to_float<T>(x_main[(bs * N + (t+1)) * C + c]) : 0.0f;
671	    float conv_out = w0 * xm1 + w1 * x0 + w2 * xp1 + bv;
672	
673	    // d/d(conv_out) of silu
674	    float sig  = ptx_sigmoidf(conv_out);
675	    float dsilu = sig * (1.0f + conv_out * (1.0f - sig));
676	
677	    float gxc = to_float<T>(grad_xc[(bs * N + t) * C + c]);
678	    float g   = gxc * dsilu;   // grad w.r.t. conv_out
679	
680	    // Accumulate grad_conv_b (one contribution per (b,t))
681	    atomicAdd(&grad_bias[c], g);
682	
683	    // Accumulate grad_conv_W: grad_W[c,k] += g * x_main[b, t+k-1, c]
684	    atomicAdd(&grad_W[c * 3 + 0], g * xm1);
685	    atomicAdd(&grad_W[c * 3 + 1], g * x0);
686	    atomicAdd(&grad_W[c * 3 + 2], g * xp1);
687	
688	    // Grad w.r.t. x_main (float buffer, safe atomicAdd for all T types):
689	    //   The conv output at position t uses x_main[t-1], x_main[t], x_main[t+1].
690	    //   So grad for x_main[t] comes from 3 output positions:
691	    //     from output[t]:   g_from_t   * W[c, 1]   (x0 role)
692	    //     from output[t+1]: g_from_tp1 * W[c, 0]   (x0 = x_main[t] acts as xm1 for t+1)
693	    //     from output[t-1]: g_from_tm1 * W[c, 2]   (x0 = x_main[t] acts as xp1 for t-1)
694	    atomicAdd(&grad_x_main_f[(bs * N + t) * C + c],         g * w1);
695	    if (t > 0)
696	        atomicAdd(&grad_x_main_f[(bs * N + (t-1)) * C + c], g * w0);
697	    if (t < N - 1)
698	        atomicAdd(&grad_x_main_f[(bs * N + (t+1)) * C + c], g * w2);
699	}
